WorkBriefingConnector.description: One connector instance as the harness reports it.

connected.description: The harness's own health verdict: connected, needing sign-in, or unreported. Advisory — each run records the truth per source.

family.description: The resolved family (`slack`, `gmail`, …) or `unknown`. Marks and evidence anchoring only, never scope authority.

id.description: The instance id in the harness's configuration — the same id `WorkSettings.enabled_connector_instances` narrows by.

WorkBriefingHarness.description: One harness as the briefing Settings surface sees it: certified or refused, with the refusal reason stated rather than the harness hidden.

connectors.description: The connector instances this harness's own configuration holds, so Settings can offer narrowing to what actually exists. Discovery, not authority: the run's scope is still computed at claim time from the harness's live configuration and the stored narrowing.

defaultModel.description: The cheapest capable model — the Fast-tier default — chosen here because the resolver deliberately refuses to invent a model at run time.

reason.description: The gate's own reason when it refused. Never a substitute suggestion.

supported.description: Whether the adapter passed the briefing conformance gate.

WorkBriefingModel.description: One model a briefing could run on, as Settings offers it.

defaultForBriefing.description: Whether this is the model a briefing defaults to on this harness.

tier.description: The capability tier, `fast` being the cheapest capable one.
